Current AN-Paint message helpers attach it to a positive message-acknowledgement button with no application-specific mutation callback. It acknowledges or closes the message; it does not promise success, saving, or acceptance of terms.

rows.consumer_context: Generic finish/close-interaction label. Used to close about/legal/language views, exit gallery/legacy screens, dismiss vertical feedback and failure notices. Drawing-setting toggles have already applied live. IMPORTANT GalleryCredits overrides Done to save() then dismiss only on success, so not universally dismissal-only or universally-save. Error notice Done does not certify success.
rows.rationale: Retain the exact generic Android Done convention, separately present as an exact label in Gallery2 after a selection interaction. In AN-Paint the common role is finishing the current interaction: some callers only close a screen, drawing settings already change live, GalleryCredits saves and validates before dismissal, and failure notices also use Done. The selected source convention must therefore be reviewed as a completion/exit button, never as an assertion that the failed operation succeeded or that every caller saved.

rows.consumer_context: Cancel current interaction, caller-specific semantics. Many negative buttons dismiss before pending changes commit. AdvancedColourDialog restores preview(original) on Cancel; trim_cancel clears trim and refits viewport; ImportSelection cancellation cleans up/calls cancellation path; SaveOptionsDialog invokes supplied cancellation callback; ImageResizeDialog onDismiss cancels if not accepted. Does not guarantee global undo, no side effects, rollback of prior changes or deletion of user source files.
rows.rationale: Use the exact AOSP generic Cancel control and Gallery2 corroboration. It can dismiss a pending dialog, abort import/save workflow callbacks, exit trim, or restore a color preview, according to the caller. It does not mean global undo or deletion. Prefer this recognizable cancel label over glossary ሰርዝ because both retained AOSP applications separately use ሰርዝ for Delete.

rows.consumer_context: Confirm/apply current validated input: NumericSlider parses integer/range then changes progress and calls setting callback; ClassicPaintActivity dimensions validates size/budget then creates/resizes canvas and fits view; AssemblyPositionDialog validates nonnegative integral coordinates and changes placement. Invalid values can keep dialog open. Not file Save or unconditional success. Existing Apply to all acceptance does not transfer automatically.
rows.rationale: Use AOSP’s exact generic Apply imperative, independently corroborated by glossary entry 149 for putting selected settings or changes into effect. Current exact-key callers validate entered numbers, placement settings, or dimensions before invoking their operation. Apply is an action request, not a completed-success report; invalid values may keep the dialog open.
